stage3_visual_observation: Person and room remain structurally coherent, but generated dancer remains close to the starting pose while the source bends progressively forward and raises a hand toward her face. No severe melting in this 25-frame window; action fidelity fails.

head_motion_measure.method: Official DWPose nose y minus midpoint-of-hips y, divided by each video's first-frame shoulder-to-pelvis distance; all nose and hip detections accepted at >=0.3 confidence
head_motion_measure.limitation: 2D measurements come from source and 30-degree generated views; useful to detect near-frozen bending, not a complete 3D action metric.

condition_visual: DD target-view dw_warp and dw_depth retain a visibly lowering head/body shape through f16/f24, so this example is not explained solely by lost geometric action conditioning.
